description: This source file is a Dart script that checks whether the current directory is the root of a Flutter project by verifying the presence of 'pubspec.yaml', 'lib/main.dart', and 'android' directory. If all are found, it prints the absolute path of the directory; otherwise, it reports an error and exits with a non-zero status.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the script that performs the check for Flutter project root.
